name: Trustedge Capital Limited
summary: Trustedge Capital Limited, an Ahmedabad, India-based non-banking financial institution established in 1995, provides a range of financing and investment services throughout India. The company assists small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and entrepreneurs with working capital solutions, such as purchase order funding, invoice factoring, and supply chain financing, as well as term loan facilities, including business credit, equipment financing, and property-backed loans. Furthermore, it offers corporate funding, encompassing growth capital and margin funding. Beyond its lending activities, Trustedge actively invests in publicly traded shares, various debt and equity instruments, and mutual funds. The firm, which previously operated as Adinath Exim Resources Limited, is slated to officially change its name to Trustedge Capital Limited in June 2025.
